Chart of accounts written to `operations/command/records/finance/chart-of-accounts.md`.

**What it covers:**

- **Assets (1000s):** financial (USD, HIVE, HBD), computation (tokens, sessions), knowledge (library, skills, instincts), work (tasks, plans), infrastructure (services, hooks, agents, commands)
- **Liabilities (2000s):** financial payables, open/blocked/overdue tasks, technical debt, stale records, attention debt (unreviewed failures/sessions, pending triage)
- **Equity (3000s):** charter, cumulative knowledge, system capability, reputation, opening balances
- **Income (4000s):** knowledge produced (terms, texts, surveys), work completed (tasks, plans, bugs), infrastructure added (capabilities, automations), financial revenue
- **Expenses (5000s):** computation by model tier (opus/sonnet/haiku/local) + API cost in USD, infrastructure (hosting, domains, software), time (session duration, captain attention), research, waste (failed sessions, rework, stale plans)

Also includes:
- 8 commodities (USD, TOKENS, TASKS, ARTIFACTS, HOURS, MESSAGES, HIVE, HBD)
- 14 standard transaction patterns mapping events to debit/credit pairs
- 6 diagnostic balance checks for the bookkeeper to monitor

Account paths use colon separators matching ledger-tool.js. Numeric IDs are for reporting hierarchy only.
